title: "02 — EV-Charging Siting Models"

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(caret)
library(car)
library(sandwich)
library(lmtest)
library(pROC)
library(randomForest)
library(readr)

set.seed(2)

panel_df <- read_csv(
  here("data", "processed", "analysis_panel_2017_2023.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

outcome <- "WithinBuffer_1mi"

predictors <- c(
  "TotalPopulation", "PopDens", "Walkability",
  "black_per", "hispanic_per", "asian_per",
  "renter_per", "MedianRent", "MedianHouseholdIncome",
  "EmployeeDiversity", "DistanceTransit",
  "hs_per", "bachelor_per", "master_per"
)

model_data <- panel_df |>
  select(Year, all_of(outcome), all_of(predictors)) |>
  rename(WithinBuffer = all_of(outcome)) |>
  mutate(WithinBuffer = as.integer(WithinBuffer)) |>
  drop_na()
```

## Shared helpers

```{r helpers}
stratified_split <- function(data, proportion = 0.80, seed = 2) {
  set.seed(seed)
  index <- caret::createDataPartition(
    data$WithinBuffer,
    p = proportion,
    list = FALSE
  )
  list(
    train = data[index, , drop = FALSE],
    test = data[-index, , drop = FALSE]
  )
}

safe_binary_metrics <- function(actual, predicted, probabilities) {
  actual <- factor(actual, levels = c(0, 1))
  predicted <- factor(predicted, levels = c(0, 1))

  cm <- table(Predicted = predicted, Actual = actual)

  tn <- cm["0", "0"]
  fn <- cm["0", "1"]
  fp <- cm["1", "0"]
  tp <- cm["1", "1"]

  tibble(
    accuracy = (tp + tn) / sum(cm),
    sensitivity = ifelse(tp + fn > 0, tp / (tp + fn), NA_real_),
    false_positive_rate = ifelse(fp + tn > 0, fp / (fp + tn), NA_real_),
    precision = ifelse(tp + fp > 0, tp / (tp + fp), NA_real_),
    auc = as.numeric(pROC::auc(actual, probabilities))
  )
}

formula_siting <- reformulate(predictors, response = "WithinBuffer")
```

## Modified Poisson models with robust standard errors

```{r modified-poisson}
run_modified_poisson <- function(data, year) {
  annual <- filter(data, Year == year)
  split <- stratified_split(annual)

  model <- glm(
    formula_siting,
    family = poisson(link = "log"),
    data = split$train
  )

  robust_table <- lmtest::coeftest(
    model,
    vcov. = sandwich::vcovHC(model, type = "HC1")
  )

  probabilities <- predict(
    model,
    newdata = split$test,
    type = "response"
  )

  roc_object <- pROC::roc(
    split$test$WithinBuffer,
    probabilities,
    quiet = TRUE
  )

  threshold <- as.numeric(
    pROC::coords(
      roc_object,
      "best",
      ret = "threshold",
      best.method = "youden"
    )
  )

  predictions <- as.integer(probabilities >= threshold)

  coefficients <- tibble(
    Year = year,
    term = rownames(robust_table),
    estimate = robust_table[, 1],
    robust_se = robust_table[, 2],
    statistic = robust_table[, 3],
    p_value = robust_table[, 4]
  )

  metrics <- safe_binary_metrics(
    split$test$WithinBuffer,
    predictions,
    probabilities
  ) |>
    mutate(
      Year = year,
      model = "Modified Poisson",
      threshold = threshold
    )

  list(model = model, coefficients = coefficients, metrics = metrics)
}

poisson_results <- map(2017:2023, ~ run_modified_poisson(model_data, .x))

poisson_coefficients <- map_dfr(poisson_results, "coefficients")
poisson_performance <- map_dfr(poisson_results, "metrics")

write_csv(
  poisson_coefficients,
  here("results", "tables", "modified_poisson_coefficients.csv")
)
write_csv(
  poisson_performance,
  here("results", "tables", "modified_poisson_performance.csv")
)
```

## Random-forest models

```{r random-forest}
run_random_forest <- function(data, year) {
  annual <- filter(data, Year == year)
  split <- stratified_split(annual, seed = 42)

  train <- split$train |>
    mutate(
      WithinBuffer = factor(
        WithinBuffer,
        levels = c(1, 0),
        labels = c("Yes", "No")
      )
    )

  test <- split$test |>
    mutate(
      WithinBuffer = factor(
        WithinBuffer,
        levels = c(1, 0),
        labels = c("Yes", "No")
      )
    )

  control <- trainControl(
    method = "cv",
    number = 10,
    classProbs = TRUE,
    summaryFunction = twoClassSummary,
    savePredictions = "final"
  )

  number_predictors <- length(predictors)
  tuning_grid <- data.frame(
    mtry = unique(
      pmax(
        1,
        round(seq(2, sqrt(number_predictors) * 1.5, length.out = 6))
      )
    )
  )

  set.seed(42)
  model <- train(
    formula_siting,
    data = train,
    method = "rf",
    trControl = control,
    metric = "ROC",
    tuneGrid = tuning_grid,
    importance = TRUE,
    na.action = na.omit
  )

  probabilities <- predict(model, newdata = test, type = "prob")[, "Yes"]
  predictions <- predict(model, newdata = test)

  actual_numeric <- ifelse(test$WithinBuffer == "Yes", 1L, 0L)
  predicted_numeric <- ifelse(predictions == "Yes", 1L, 0L)

  importance_matrix <- randomForest::importance(
    model$finalModel,
    type = 1
  )

  importance_table <- tibble(
    Year = year,
    variable = rownames(importance_matrix),
    importance = importance_matrix[, 1]
  ) |>
    arrange(desc(importance))

  metrics <- safe_binary_metrics(
    actual_numeric,
    predicted_numeric,
    probabilities
  ) |>
    mutate(
      Year = year,
      model = "Random Forest",
      best_mtry = model$bestTune$mtry
    )

  list(model = model, importance = importance_table, metrics = metrics)
}

rf_results <- map(2017:2023, ~ run_random_forest(model_data, .x))

rf_importance <- map_dfr(rf_results, "importance")
rf_performance <- map_dfr(rf_results, "metrics")

write_csv(
  rf_importance,
  here("results", "tables", "random_forest_importance.csv")
)
write_csv(
  rf_performance,
  here("results", "tables", "random_forest_performance.csv")
)
```

## Combined performance table

```{r combined-performance}
model_performance <- bind_rows(
  poisson_performance,
  rf_performance
) |>
  arrange(Year, model)

write_csv(
  model_performance,
  here("results", "tables", "siting_model_performance.csv")
)

model_performance
```
